abstract: Maintains emergency egress analysis and crowd evacuation benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Fire and Life Safety Inspector (SAFE), responsible for maintaining emergency egress analyses, crowd evacuation benchmarks, and safety drill performance data across potential convention and exhibition venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency egress analysis and crowd evacuation benchmarks（LIFE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-LIFE-EQJ：For Danube Waterfront Arena, the maximum emergency crowd evacuation time modeled for a full venue capacity of 12,000 concurrent attendees to reach public assembly zones is 13 min.
SAFE-LIFE-020：For Bavaria International Congress Center, the computational egress simulation under full venue occupancy of 12,000 concurrent attendees establishes a maximum emergency crowd evacuation time of 9 min.
SAFE-LIFE-X5E：For Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion, the maximum emergency crowd evacuation time determined via computational egress simulation for 12,000 concurrent attendees across the full venue is 11 min.

information_points.title: Evacuation simulation drills（DRILL）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DRILL-URW：Municipal fire safety compliance registry records indicate that Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion logged an annual safety drill completion rate of 80% during operational drills conducted over the past 12 calendar months.
SAFE-DRILL-51W：According to municipal fire safety compliance records covering the past 12 calendar months, Bavaria International Congress Center attained an annual safety drill completion rate of 100%.
SAFE-DRILL-DCX：Records from the municipal fire safety compliance registry show Danube Waterfront Arena achieved an annual safety drill completion rate of 90% over the past 12 calendar months of scheduled drills.
